stem: Interveinal chlorosis appears only in one irrigation zone. Which differential is strongest?
choices: Declare a micronutrient deficiency from color alone.
Ignore irrigation because leaf symptoms cannot arise from root-zone conditions.
Keep nutrition, localized delivery/root-zone conditions and other look-alikes open until zone evidence separates them.
rationale: Keep nutrition, localized delivery/root-zone conditions and other look-alikes open until zone evidence separates them.
